title: Kitchen
info: The kitchen has heat, knives, and slippery floors.
Wash your hands before you touch food.
Knives and the stove are adult jobs unless an adult is teaching you and watching.

questions.q: Before you touch food, you should
options: Lick the spoon and put it back
You leave it in soapy water hidden
An adult is teaching you and watching
Out where arms can knock them

questions.q: If oil in a pan smokes or flames
options: Pick the pan up and run
Get an adult. Do not throw water on an oil fire

questions.q: A wet floor in the kitchen
options: Dries only if you ignore it
Is the best place to race

questions.q: Type the room where the stove usually is.
